text:
maria: Kickoff: thinking about a "fallback choreography" UX that separates detection, preview, and enact. Goal: let operators understand which requests would have moved and why before any real routing change.
ajay: yes please. Two parts: detect rules (metrics + windows) and action rules (percent routed, fallback chain). We should support partial routing (e.g., 20% shift) for canary fallback.
dana: Console idea: a compact timeline + request overlay. You can scrub to a time and the UI overlays which requests would be detoured and shows the rule that matched. :mag_right:
leah: important: each simulated decision must expose the exact decision factors (metric values, sample count, window) and a decision_id so we can trace it into logs.
ben: operational constraints: need cooldown/hysteresis and a max-switch-per-hour guard. otherwise we'll flip models under noisy network conditions.
maria: agreed. propose defaults: sustained = error_rate >= 4% for 3m -> route 100% after a 1m cooldown; transient = error_rate >= 12% for 20s -> simulate only. open to numbers.
ajay: API-wise: POST /policies/simulate {policy_id, start_ts, end_ts} -> returns decisions[] with {decision_id, ts, type: sustained|transient, reasons:[...], affected_count, affected_request_ids[]} (decision reasons humanized). Need to ensure request IDs are hashed to avoid leaking PII.
dana: UI should show both the raw JSON and a plain English summary: "Between 12:02-12:06, 37 requests would have been routed to fallback due to error_rate=6.1% (502s)." Add an expected cost delta badge next to each decision.
leah: audit model: every enacted decision writes immutable row: decision_id, policy_id, window, metric_snapshot, action_taken, operator (nullable), operator_note (optional, free text, stored separately but linked). Retention: 7 days full, 1 year aggregated; ops can request export.
ben: security: when we capture request payload snippets we must run PII scrubber and annotate fields removed. Also require that audit export is signed and encrypted (KMS).
maria: feedback: let's allow two action modes for a policy: dry_run (counts only) and enforce. The console's toggle should be prominent and default to dry_run for new policies.
ajay: implementation detail: decisions must be idempotent. Include decision_context token in request header so the router can return the canonical decision_id. Also avoid loops by disallowing a fallback that targets a model whose policy points back to the original. We can validate policy graphs at save-time.
dana: visualization: render fallback chains as a small DAG with percentages on edges. If a fallback target is missing, highlight in red and prevent enable.
leah: operator flow: when a policy triggers and an operator intervenes, they should be able to annotate the audit entry: tags like "escalated_infra", "mitigated_known_issue" plus free text. The UI should show these tags inline with the immutable decision row.
ben: edgecase: fallback overloaded -> we need backoff and an emergency "route-to-degraded" mode where we return cached shorter responses rather than hitting fallback. Need to reflect that in policy actions too.
maria: for the preview screen, add filters: by error_class, by client_id, by route_name. Also small share link to a snapshot so you can send to SREs.
ajay: API contract suggestion for simulation response: decision objects are compact strings for serialized fields to keep logs small (no nested objects). We'll return arrays of strings like ["decision_id:123", "ts:171235...", "type:sustained", "reason:error_rate=0.061;window=180s"].
dana: UX nit: show a histogram of decisions over the preview range (bars = how many requests per minute would detour). Clicking a bar expands the request list.
leah: compliance: add an export format that includes field-level redaction markers so auditors can verify redaction was applied.
maria: next steps: ajay owners API draft, dana will mock preview + DAG view, leah will draft audit schema + retention + redaction rules, ben will list failure modes (fallback overload, policy-loop detection). I'll collect and schedule a short review next week.
policy-bot: simulation "fallback-choreo-sim" started (id sim-1712359999-1). Results will be available at /console/policies/simulations/sim-1712359999-1 :robot_face:
maria: thanks all. Drop a 1-line blocker if you hit one by EOD.
